events.title: Release date and price: 17 November!
events.summary: Greetings, emperors!Imperium Sine Fine: Eternal Emperor will be released on Tuesday 17 November at 18:00 CET. That’s 17:00 GMT, 12:00 noon US Eastern and 09:00 US Pacific. The store page now shows the date.Eternal Emperor costs 14.99 USD.Eternal Creation, the scenario editor, is released the same day for 4.99 USD. events.title: Steam Next Fest is live, try the demo!
events.summary: Greetings, emperors!Steam Next Fest has started, and Imperium Sine Fine is taking part! Until 26 October you can try hundreds of upcoming games for free, and the demo is one of them.Play as the Human faction, Imperium, on small maps with no time or turn limit. It includes the living population in every city, grain and stone, engineers, the new combat system, Military Tradition and crime, plus the balance changes that came out of your feedback. events.title: The road ahead, Vassalage, Pestilence and the Chronicles of Cardolya
events.summary: Greetings, emperors!A new development blog post is up, and this one looks at what comes after release. Three updates are planned: two free ones for everyone, and one DLC I’m especially excited about. All three are for the desktop version.Vassalage & Subjugation (free, mid-December) lets an empire bow to a stronger one, pay tribute and live under its protection, instead of being conquered.Pestilence (free, mid-January) brings disease to the world. events.summary: Greetings, emperors!Part two of the modding series is up on the blog! Last time I explained how the modding system works. This post covers how to share what you make.The simplest way is to zip up your mod folder and send it to a friend. For reaching the whole community, the Steam Workshop is the proper route, and I’ve built a small standalone tool, the Workshop Uploader, to make it easy. basic_info.short_description: Your generals grow old. Your cities grow restless. Your empire need not end. Lead one of 14 factions in a living fantasy world of grand strategy, where populations migrate, crime festers, and every grain shipment matters. Build, conquer, and rule, without end.
